mainEntity.name: What is a jailbroken Fire Stick?

acceptedAnswer.text: A jailbroken Fire Stick is a Fire TV device with sideloading enabled and apps like Kodi or Stremio pre-installed. StreamStickPro offers pre-configured devices ready to stream.
